rationale.loss: Recent losers rarely reach +1%. Advance existing -1.2% protection from 10m to 5m only when MFE stays below half the +1% arm and current loss exceeds half the -1.2% cut. Preserve the initial stop.
rationale.profit: Arm existing half-peak lock at +1.5% (previous hypothesis), and only widen future trailing proposals during three rising completed closes to twice ATR, capped at the original 2.5% risk width. Never loosen a stored stop.
rationale.thresholds: Engineering hypotheses derived from current rule scales; not optimized or validated.
